latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Editor AI Easy, designed for beginner creators to quickly edit raw video footage into polished clips with AI.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM uploads up to 500MB; renders on cloud GPUs at 1080p and returns edited MP4 files in 30-60 seconds.
- Includes automatic token and session management for easy setup and use.
- Offers fast cloud-based trimming, transitions, and audio cleanup with minimal manual effort.
- Built-in prompt routing to handle exports, credits, uploads, and editing actions via user-friendly commands.
- Provides clear feedback on job status and guides users through common editing workflows.
